ops-announce-bot: :mega: Community Summit — Call for Projects + redwood-playgrounds v0.1.0-beta release

ops-announce-bot: Quick heads-up: we're running a community summit on 2026-06-15 (virtual + SF office). If you maintain a public repo or small demo, please submit a short lightning demo (5-10 min) or a 'playground' template.

What we shipped today
ops-announce-bot: Released a beta of the community repo `redwood-playgrounds` (v0.1.0-beta). It includes three template playbooks: quick-text, embeddings-explorer, and chat-tooling. Docs + minimal demos are in the repo.

Release checklist (maintainers, please follow):
```
- update CHANGELOG.md
- create semver tag (v0.x.y-beta)
- add `summit-presenter` label to the release issue if you want a demo slot
- ensure README has --local demo instruction
```

How to sign up
ops-announce-bot: Add the `summit-presenter` label to your repo issue or fill the short form: https://go.redwood/summit-2026

mike: I'll add a playground for embeddings use-case — ETA Fri. :+1:

sasha: Can we get a 7-min demo slot? Also can we add a short license blurb to the templates? CC @jen

jen: tagging infra — @jamal can you give a 5-min segment on Dedicated routing/fallback?

jamal: yep I can do 5 mins. will show routing fallback + cost comparison chart. planning to use the small dev GPU queue.

devrel-bot: :sparkles: New release published: redwood-playgrounds v0.1.0-beta — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-playgrounds/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta

ana: pushed PR #264 with a chat-tooling demo and added `summit-presenter` label.

mike: do we want a CI matrix for the demos? some templates need smaller GPU to run locally.

sasha: recommend `--local` mode in README and a `make demo-local` target. keeps infra light.

ops-announce-bot: Friendly reminder: maintainers office hours next Tue 9am PT. Book a slot here: https://go.redwood/office-hours

jen: will coordinate the runbook for the live stream. ping me if you need recording access.

sasha: thanks all — excited to see what the community builds! :rocket:
